tool_schemas.name: maps_geocode
tool_schemas.description: Geocodes a free-form address (optionally biased by components, bounds, region, and language) under the given workspace and API key, returning the provider’s geocoding response and creating a normalized operation log entry including status and cost/quota usage; when dedupe=true, an identical cached operation may be returned and linked for audit. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if required fields are missing/invalid (including ID patterns or malformed bounds), NOT_FOUND if the workspace or api_key_id does not exist (or is not associated with the workspace), UNAUTHORIZED if the API key is disabled/invalid for use, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the workspace or key has insufficient remaining quota/budget for the operation.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID to run the request under.

api_key_id.description: API key record ID used for authentication and audit attribution.

components.description: Component filters as key/value pairs (e.g., country, postal_code) to narrow results.

southwest.description: Southwest corner of the bounding box.

northeast.description: Northeast corner of the bounding box.

bounds.description: Bounding box to bias geocoding results.

region.description: Region code to bias results (defaults to workspace default_region if set).

language.description: Language code for results (defaults to workspace default_language if set).

dedupe.description: If true, return a cached identical request when available and record dedupe linkage.

tool_schemas.name: maps_reverse_geocode
tool_schemas.description: Reverse-geocodes a latitude/longitude pair into address results (optionally filtered by result_type/location_type and localized by language) under the given workspace and API key, returning the provider’s reverse-geocode response and recording the full request/response, status, and cost/quota usage; when dedupe=true, an identical cached operation may be returned and linked. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for missing/invalid inputs (including ID patterns or invalid lat/lng shape), NOT_FOUND if the workspace or api_key_id cannot be resolved (or is not linked), UNAUTHORIZED if the API key cannot be used, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if the request would exceed enforced usage limits.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID to run the request under.

api_key_id.description: API key record ID used for authentication and audit attribution.

latlng.description: Coordinate pair to convert into an address.

result_type.description: Optional list of address type filters to restrict results.

location_type.description: Optional list of location type filters to restrict results.

language.description: Language code for results (defaults to workspace default_language if set).

dedupe.description: If true, return a cached identical request when available and record dedupe linkage.

tool_schemas.name: maps_search_places
tool_schemas.description: Runs a Google Places text search for the given query (optionally biased by location/radius, filtered by type, and localized by language/region) under the given workspace and API key, returning the provider’s search response and persisting an operation log entry with status and cost/quota accounting. Results are paged by the provider using page_token: omit it for the first page and pass the returned next_page_token to fetch subsequent pages, with each page recorded as its own operation (dedupe may return a cached identical page when enabled). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for missing/invalid inputs (including radius_meters minimum and invalid ID patterns), NOT_FOUND for unknown/unlinked workspace or api_key_id, UNAUTHORIZED for disabled/invalid API keys, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when limits prevent executing the search.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID to run the request under.

api_key_id.description: API key record ID used for authentication and audit attribution.

query.description: Text query to search for places.

location.description: Optional location to bias search results.

radius_meters.description: Optional radius in meters to bias results around location.

type.description: Optional place type filter to restrict results.

language.description: Language code for results (defaults to workspace default_language if set).

region.description: Region code to bias results (defaults to workspace default_region if set).

page_token.description: Token to retrieve the next page of results.

dedupe.description: If true, return a cached identical request when available and record dedupe linkage.

tool_schemas.name: maps_place_details
tool_schemas.description: Fetches detailed information for a specific Google place_id (optionally limited by fields and localized by language/region, with optional session_token) under the given workspace and API key, returning the provider’s details payload and storing a normalized operation log with status and cost/quota usage; when dedupe=true, an identical cached operation may be returned and linked. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if place_id or other inputs are missing/invalid (including ID patterns), NOT_FOUND if the workspace or api_key_id cannot be found or is not associated, UNAUTHORIZED if the API key is not permitted/active, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when the workspace/key quota or budget would be exceeded by the call.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID to run the request under.

api_key_id.description: API key record ID used for authentication and audit attribution.

place_id.description: Google Place ID to fetch details for.

fields.description: Optional list of fields to return to control payload size and billing.

language.description: Language code for results (defaults to workspace default_language if set).

region.description: Region code to bias results (defaults to workspace default_region if set).

session_token.description: Optional session token to group autocomplete/details billing behavior.

dedupe.description: If true, return a cached identical request when available and record dedupe linkage.

tool_schemas.name: maps_distance_matrix
tool_schemas.description: Computes travel distances and durations between one or more origins and destinations (optionally with mode, units, time/traffic and transit preferences, and localization) under the given workspace and API key, returning the provider’s distance matrix response and recording an operation log entry with status and cost/quota usage; when dedupe=true, an identical cached operation may be returned and linked. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for missing/invalid inputs (including empty origins/destinations, invalid enums, or invalid ID patterns), NOT_FOUND if the workspace or api_key_id is unknown or not linked, UNAUTHORIZED if the API key is disabled/invalid, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED if usage enforcement blocks the request.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID to run the request under.

api_key_id.description: API key record ID used for authentication and audit attribution.

origins.description: List of origin locations as address strings or 'lat,lng' strings.

destinations.description: List of destination locations as address strings or 'lat,lng' strings.

mode.description: Travel mode used to compute distances and durations.

language.description: Language code for results (defaults to workspace default_language if set).

region.description: Region code to bias results (defaults to workspace default_region if set).

units.description: Unit system to use in results.

departure_time.description: Optional departure time for traffic-aware results (RFC3339 timestamp or provider-supported literal).

arrival_time.description: Optional arrival time for transit results (RFC3339 timestamp or provider-supported literal).

traffic_model.description: Optional traffic model used when computing durations in traffic.

transit_mode.description: Optional list of preferred transit modes to use when mode=transit.

transit_routing_preference.description: Optional transit routing preference when mode=transit.

avoid.description: Optional list of route features to avoid.

dedupe.description: If true, return a cached identical request when available and record dedupe linkage.

tool_schemas.name: maps_elevation
tool_schemas.description: Returns elevation data for the requested locations under the given workspace and API key, persisting a normalized elevation operation log including inputs, provider output, status, and cost/quota accounting; when dedupe=true, an identical cached operation may be returned and linked for audit. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR when required parameters are missing or malformed (including invalid ID patterns or invalid location shapes), NOT_FOUND if the workspace or api_key_id cannot be resolved (or is not associated with the workspace), UNAUTHORIZED if the API key is not active/authorized for elevation requests, and QUOTA_EXCEEDED when executing the request would exceed enforced workspace/key limits.

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID to run the request under.

api_key_id.description: API key record ID used for authentication and audit attribution.

locations.description: List of locations to retrieve elevation for.

dedupe.description: If true, return a cached identical request when available and record dedupe linkage.

tool_schemas.implementation:
def maps_elevation(workspace_id, api_key_id, locations, dedupe=None, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, time, re, hashlib

    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0280000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0280000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f:
                return json.load(f)
        except Exception:
            return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x):
        return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    t0 = time.time()
    tool_name = "maps_elevation"

    def _now():
        return datetime.datetime.now(datetime.timezone.utc)

    def _now_iso():
        return _now().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")

    def _parse_dt(s):
        if s is None:
            return None
        if not isinstance(s, str) or not s:
            return None
        try:
            if s.endswith("Z"):
                s = s[:-1] + "+00:00"
            dt = datetime.datetime.fromisoformat(s)
            if dt.tzinfo is None:
                dt = dt.replace(tzinfo=datetime.timezone.utc)
            return dt.astimezone(datetime.timezone.utc)
        except Exception:
            return None

    def _new_req_id():
        h = hashlib.sha256((str(time.time_ns()) + os.urandom(16).hex()).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:24].upper()
        return "gmap_req_" + h

    def _period_bounds(dt, period_type):
        if period_type == "day":
            ps = dt.replace(hour=0, minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0)
            pe = ps + datetime.timedelta(days=1)
        else:
            ps = dt.replace(day=1, hour=0, minute=0, second=0, microsecond=0)
            if ps.month == 12:
                pe = ps.replace(year=ps.year + 1, month=1)
            else:
                pe = ps.replace(month=ps.month + 1)
        return ps, pe

    def _iso(dt):
        return dt.replace(microsecond=0).isoformat().replace("+00:00", "Z")

    def _ensure_rollup(usage_rollups, ws_id, period_type, ps, pe, tool_bucket, now_iso):
        ps_iso = _iso(ps)
        pe_iso = _iso(pe)
        for r in usage_rollups:
            if (
                r.get("workspace_id") == ws_id
                and r.get("period_type") == period_type
                and r.get("period_start") == ps_iso
                and r.get("tool_name") == tool_bucket
            ):
                return r
        rid = hashlib.sha256(f"{ws_id}|{period_type}|{ps_iso}|{tool_bucket}".encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()[:24].upper()
        row = {
            "id": "gmap_usg_" + rid,
            "workspace_id": ws_id,
            "period_start": ps_iso,
            "period_end": pe_iso,
            "period_type": period_type,
            "tool_name": tool_bucket,
            "request_count": 0,
            "billable_units": 0,
            "estimated_cost_usd": 0.0,
            "created_at": now_iso,
            "updated_at": now_iso,
        }
        usage_rollups.append(row)
        return row

    def _update_rollups_terminal(usage_rollups, ws_id, tool, billable_units, cost_usd, now_dt):
        now_iso = _iso(now_dt)
        for period_type in ("day", "month"):
            ps, pe = _period_bounds(now_dt, period_type)
            for bucket in (tool, "*"):
                r = _ensure_rollup(usage_rollups, ws_id, period_type, ps, pe, bucket, now_iso)
                r["request_count"] = int(r.get("request_count") or 0) + 1
                r["billable_units"] = int(r.get("billable_units") or 0) + int(billable_units)
                r["estimated_cost_usd"] = float(r.get("estimated_cost_usd") or 0.0) + float(cost_usd)
                r["updated_at"] = now_iso

    def _current_period_usage(usage_rollups, ws_id, period_type, now_dt):
        ps, _pe = _period_bounds(now_dt, period_type)
        ps_iso = _iso(ps)
        req = 0
        cost = 0.0
        for r in usage_rollups:
            if r.get("workspace_id") == ws_id and r.get("period_type") == period_type and r.get("period_start") == ps_iso and r.get("tool_name") == "*":
                req += int(r.get("request_count") or 0)
                cost += float(r.get("estimated_cost_usd") or 0.0)
        return req, cost

    def _append_request(maps_requests, ws_id, key_id, pcn_id, status, payload, normalized_input=None, cache_key=None,
                        provider_http_method=None, provider_url=None, provider_status_code=None, provider_request_id=None,
                        response=None, error_code=None, error_message=None, billable_units=0, estimated_cost_usd=0.0,
                        deduped_from_request_id=None):
        now_iso = _now_iso()
        row = {
            "id": _new_req_id(),
            "workspace_id": ws_id,
            "api_key_id": key_id,
            "provider_connection_id": pcn_id,
            "tool_name": tool_name,
            "status": status,
            "input": payload,
            "normalized_input": normalized_input,
            "cache_key": cache_key,
            "provider_http_method": provider_http_method,
            "provider_url": provider_url,
            "provider_status_code": provider_status_code,
            "provider_request_id": provider_request_id,
            "response": response,
            "error_code": error_code,
            "error_message": error_message,
            "latency_ms": max(0, int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)),
            "billable_units": int(billable_units),
            "estimated_cost_usd": float(estimated_cost_usd),
            "deduped_from_request_id": deduped_from_request_id,
            "created_at": now_iso,
            "updated_at": now_iso,
        }
        maps_requests.append(row)
        return row

    # ---- Validate inputs
    if not isinstance(workspace_id, str) or not re.match(r"^gmap_ws_[0-9A-Z]{18,}$", workspace_id):
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Invalid workspace_id format.")
    if not isinstance(api_key_id, str) or not re.match(r"^gmap_key_[0-9A-Z]{18,}$", api_key_id):
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Invalid api_key_id format.")
    if not isinstance(locations, list) or len(locations) < 1:
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "locations must be a non-empty array.")
    for i, loc in enumerate(locations):
        if not isinstance(loc, dict) or set(loc.keys()) != {"lat", "lng"}:
            return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", f"locations[{i}] must be an object with lat and lng.")
        lat = loc.get("lat")
        lng = loc.get("lng")
        if not isinstance(lat, (int, float)) or not isinstance(lng, (int, float)):
            return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", f"locations[{i}].lat and .lng must be numbers.")
        if lat < -90 or lat > 90 or lng < -180 or lng > 180:
            return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", f"locations[{i}] out of range.")
    if dedupe is not None and not isinstance(dedupe, bool):
        return _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "dedupe must be a boolean when provided.")

    # ---- Load store
    workspaces = _load("workspaces.json") or []
    api_keys = _load("api_keys.json") or []
    provider_connections = _load("provider_connections.json") or []
    maps_requests = _load("maps_requests.json") or []
    usage_rollups = _load("usage_rollups.json") or []

    # ---- Authenticate (by id, never by hashes/ciphertexts)
    ws = next((w for w in workspaces if w.get("id") == workspace_id), None)
    if not ws:
        # record attempt if we can attribute key->workspace, else hard NOT_FOUND
        key_row_any = next((k for k in api_keys if k.get("id") == api_key_id), None)
        if key_row_any and key_row_any.get("workspace_id"):
            _append_request(
                maps_requests,
                key_row_any.get("workspace_id"),
                api_key_id,
                "gmap_pcn_NONE",
                "failed",
                {"workspace_id": workspace_id, "api_key_id": api_key_id, "locations": locations, "dedupe": dedupe},
                error_code="workspace_inactive",
                error_message="Workspace not found.",
                billable_units=0,
                estimated_cost_usd=0.0,
            )
            _save("maps_requests.json", maps_requests)
        return _err("NOT_FOUND", "Workspace not found.")
    key_row = next((k for k in api_keys if k.get("id") == api_key_id), None)
    if not key_row:
        _append_request(
            maps_requests,
            workspace_id,
            api_key_id,
            "gmap_pcn_NONE",
            "failed",
            {"workspace_id": workspace_id, "api_key_id": api_key_id, "locations": locations, "dedupe": dedupe},
            error_code="api_key_revoked_or_expired",
            error_message="API key not found.",
            billable_units=0,
            estimated_cost_usd=0.0,
        )
        _save("maps_requests.json", maps_requests)
        return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "API key not found.")
    if key_row.get("workspace_id") != workspace_id:
        # bugfix: do not return UNAUTHORIZED if request can still be served by selecting correct workspace;
        # but this tool explicitly supplies workspace_id, so mismatch is unauthorized.
        _append_request(
            maps_requests,
            workspace_id,
            api_key_id,
            "gmap_pcn_NONE",
            "failed",
            {"workspace_id": workspace_id, "api_key_id": api_key_id, "locations": locations, "dedupe": dedupe},
            error_code="api_key_revoked_or_expired",
            error_message="API key does not belong to the workspace.",
            billable_units=0,
            estimated_cost_usd=0.0,
        )
        _save("maps_requests.json", maps_requests)
        return _err("UNAUTHORIZED", "API key does not belong to the workspace.")

    now_dt = _now()

    # ---- Preflight checks; must still record failed requests
    if ws.get("status") != "active":
        req = _append_request(
            maps_requests,
            workspace_id,
            api_key_id,
            "gmap_pcn_NONE",
            "failed",
            {"workspace_id": workspace_id, "api_key_id": api_key_id, "locations": locations, "dedupe": dedupe},
            normalized_input=None,
            cache_key=None,
            error_code="workspace_inactive",
            error_message="Workspace is suspended/deleted; rejecting request before provider call.",
            billable_units=0,
            estimated_cost_usd=0.0,
        )
        _save("maps_requests.json", maps_requests)
        return {"request": req}

    if key_row.get("status") != "active":
        req = _append_request(
            maps_requests,
            workspace_id,
            api_key_id,
            "gmap_pcn_NONE",
            "failed",
            {"workspace_id": workspace_id, "api_key_id": api_key_id, "locations": locations, "dedupe": dedupe},
            error_code="api_key_revoked_or_expired",
            error_message="Blocked before provider call: api_key status not active or expired.",
            billable_units=0,
            estimated_cost_usd=0.0,
        )
        _save("maps_requests.json", maps_requests)
        return {"request": req}

    exp = _parse_dt(key_row.get("expires_at"))
    if exp is not None and not (exp > now_dt):
        req = _append_request(
            maps_requests,
            workspace_id,
            api_key_id,
            "gmap_pcn_NONE",
            "failed",
            {"workspace_id": workspace_id, "api_key_id": api_key_id, "locations": locations, "dedupe": dedupe},
            error_code="api_key_revoked_or_expired",
            error_message="Blocked before provider call: api_key status not active or expired.",
            billable_units=0,
            estimated_cost_usd=0.0,
        )
        _save("maps_requests.json", maps_requests)
        return {"request": req}

    # Find an active provider connection that allows this endpoint for this workspace
    pcn = None
    for c in provider_connections:
        if c.get("workspace_id") == workspace_id and c.get("provider") == "google_maps_platform":
            allowed = c.get("allowed_endpoints") or []
            if isinstance(allowed, list) and tool_name in allowed:
                pcn = c
                break
    if not pcn:
        req = _append_request(
            maps_requests,
            workspace_id,
            api_key_id,
            "gmap_pcn_NONE",
            "failed",
            {"workspace_id": workspace_id, "api_key_id": api_key_id, "locations": locations, "dedupe": dedupe},
            error_code="provider_connection_error",
            error_message="No provider connection configured that allows this endpoint.",
            billable_units=0,
            estimated_cost_usd=0.0,
        )
        _save("maps_requests.json", maps_requests)
        return {"request": req}

    if pcn.get("status") != "active":
        ec = "provider_connection_disabled" if pcn.get("status") == "disabled" else "provider_connection_error"
        em = "Provider connection is disabled; request blocked preflight." if ec == "provider_connection_disabled" else "Provider connection error; request blocked preflight."
        req = _append_request(
            maps_requests,
            workspace_id,
            api_key_id,
            pcn.get("id"),
            "failed",
            {"workspace_id": workspace_id, "api_key_id": api_key_id, "locations": locations, "dedupe": dedupe},
            error_code=ec,
            error_message=em,
            billable_units=0,
            estimated_cost_usd=0.0,
        )
        _save("maps_requests.json", maps_requests)
        return {"request": req}

    # ---- Normalize + cost
    norm_locs = [{"lat": round(float(l["lat"]), 6), "lng": round(float(l["lng"]), 6)} for l in locations]
    normalized_input = {"locations": norm_locs, "locations_count": len(norm_locs)}
    billable_units = max(0, int(len(norm_locs)))
    # Simple offline pricing model: $0.005 per location (non-negative, derived from normalized_input)
    estimated_cost_usd = max(0.0, float(len(norm_locs)) * 0.005)

    cache_key = None
    if dedupe:
        cache_key = hashlib.sha256((tool_name + "|" + json.dumps(normalized_input, sort_keys=True, separators=(",", ":"))).encode("utf-8")).hexdigest()

    # ---- Quota enforcement (projected)
    day_req, day_cost = _current_period_usage(usage_rollups, workspace_id, "day", now_dt)
    mon_req, mon_cost = _current_period_usage(usage_rollups, workspace_id, "month", now_dt)

    proj_day_req = day_req + 1
    proj_mon_req = mon_req + 1
    proj_day_cost = day_cost + estimated_cost_usd
    proj_mon_cost = mon_cost + estimated_cost_usd

    if (
        proj_day_req > int(ws.get("quota_daily_requests") or 0)
        or proj_mon_req > int(ws.get("quota_monthly_requests") or 0)
        or proj_day_cost > float(ws.get("quota_daily_cost_usd") or 0.0)
        or proj_mon_cost > float(ws.get("quota_monthly_cost_usd") or 0.0)
    ):
        req = _append_request(
            maps_requests,
            workspace_id,
            api_key_id,
            pcn.get("id"),
            "failed",
            {"workspace_id": workspace_id, "api_key_id": api_key_id, "locations": locations, "dedupe": dedupe},
            normalized_input=normalized_input,
            cache_key=cache_key,
            error_code="quota_exceeded",
            error_message="Projected daily/monthly quota or cost cap exceeded for workspace.",
            billable_units=billable_units,
            estimated_cost_usd=estimated_cost_usd,
        )
        _update_rollups_terminal(usage_rollups, workspace_id, tool_name, billable_units, estimated_cost_usd, now_dt)
        key_row["last_used_at"] = _now_iso()
        key_row["updated_at"] = _now_iso()
        _save("maps_requests.json", maps_requests)
        _save("usage_rollups.json", usage_rollups)
        _save("api_keys.json", api_keys)
        return {"request": req}

    # ---- Caching (serve from previous succeeded if present)
    if cache_key:
        cached = None
        for r in reversed(maps_requests):
            if r.get("tool_name") == tool_name and r.get("cache_key") == cache_key and r.get("status") == "succeeded":
                cached = r
                break
        if cached is not None:
            req = _append_request(
                maps_requests,
                workspace_id,
                api_key_id,
                pcn.get("id"),
                "succeeded",
                {"workspace_id": workspace_id, "api_key_id": api_key_id, "locations": locations, "dedupe": dedupe},
                normalized_input=normalized_input,
                cache_key=cache_key,
                response=cached.get("response"),
                billable_units=billable_units,
                estimated_cost_usd=estimated_cost_usd,
                deduped_from_request_id=cached.get("id"),
            )
            _update_rollups_terminal(usage_rollups, workspace_id, tool_name, billable_units, estimated_cost_usd, now_dt)
            key_row["last_used_at"] = _now_iso()
            key_row["updated_at"] = _now_iso()
            _save("maps_requests.json", maps_requests)
            _save("usage_rollups.json", usage_rollups)
            _save("api_keys.json", api_keys)
            return {"request": req, "cached_from_request": cached}

    # ---- "Provider call" (offline deterministic response) and terminal write
    provider_url = "https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/elevation/json"
    results = []
    for loc in norm_locs:
        # deterministic pseudo-elevation
        elev = round((loc["lat"] * 3.0 + loc["lng"] * 2.0) % 1500.0, 3)
        results.append({"location": loc, "elevation": elev, "resolution": 4.771975994110107})
    provider_response = {"status": "OK", "results": results}

    req = _append_request(
        maps_requests,
        workspace_id,
        api_key_id,
        pcn.get("id"),
        "succeeded",
        {"workspace_id": workspace_id, "api_key_id": api_key_id, "locations": locations, "dedupe": dedupe},
        normalized_input=normalized_input,
        cache_key=cache_key,
        provider_http_method="GET",
        provider_url=provider_url,
        provider_status_code=200,
        provider_request_id=None,
        response=provider_response,
        billable_units=billable_units,
        estimated_cost_usd=estimated_cost_usd,
    )

    _update_rollups_terminal(usage_rollups, workspace_id, tool_name, billable_units, estimated_cost_usd, now_dt)
    key_row["last_used_at"] = _now_iso()
    key_row["updated_at"] = _now_iso()

    _save("maps_requests.json", maps_requests)
    _save("usage_rollups.json", usage_rollups)
    _save("api_keys.json", api_keys)
    return {"request": req, "response": provider_response}

tool_schemas.name: maps_directions

workspace_id.description: Workspace ID to run the request under.

api_key_id.description: API key record ID used for authentication and audit attribution.

origin.description: Origin as an address string or 'lat,lng' string.

destination.description: Destination as an address string or 'lat,lng' string.

mode.description: Travel mode to use when computing directions.

waypoints.description: Optional list of intermediate waypoints as address strings or 'lat,lng' strings.

alternatives.description: If true, request multiple alternative routes when available.

avoid.description: Optional list of route features to avoid.

language.description: Language code for results (defaults to workspace default_language if set).

region.description: Region code to bias results (defaults to workspace default_region if set).

units.description: Unit system to use in results.

departure_time.description: Optional departure time for traffic-aware routes (RFC3339 timestamp or provider-supported literal).

arrival_time.description: Optional arrival time for transit routes (RFC3339 timestamp or provider-supported literal).

traffic_model.description: Optional traffic model used when computing durations in traffic.

transit_mode.description: Optional list of preferred transit modes to use when mode=transit.

transit_routing_preference.description: Optional transit routing preference when mode=transit.

dedupe.description: If true, return a cached identical request when available and record dedupe linkage.

tool_schemas.name: maps_list_workspaces
tool_schemas.description: Lists workspaces visible to the caller, with optional filtering by lifecycle status and basic text search; returns a paginated result set and refuses requests with invalid pagination or unsupported filters (VALIDATION_ERROR).

api_key_id.description: API key record ID used to authorize the caller and scope results.

query.description: Optional case-insensitive search against workspace name.

limit.description: Maximum number of records to return (default 50, max 200).

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response.

tool_schemas.name: maps_create_workspace
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new workspace owned/accessible by the calling identity and returns the created workspace; refuses creation when the caller is not entitled or input is invalid (FORBIDDEN, VALIDATION_ERROR).

api_key_id.description: API key record ID used to authorize the caller creating the workspace.

default_region.description: Default region code used to bias requests when region is omitted (e.g., 'us').

default_language.description: Default language code used when language is omitted (e.g., 'en').

quota_daily_requests.description: Daily request cap for this workspace.

quota_monthly_requests.description: Monthly request cap for this workspace.

quota_daily_cost_usd.description: Daily USD cost cap for this workspace.

quota_monthly_cost_usd.description: Monthly USD cost cap for this workspace.

tool_schemas.name: maps_update_workspace
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable workspace fields and/or transitions its lifecycle status according to the declared state machine; returns the updated workspace and refuses illegal transitions or updates to deleted workspaces (CONFLICT, VALIDATION_ERROR, NOT_FOUND).

api_key_id.description: API key record ID used to authorize the update.

status.description: Lifecycle transition target. Allowed: active→suspended/deleted, suspended→active/deleted.

tool_schemas.name: maps_create_api_key
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new API key record for a workspace and returns the key once at creation time; refuses creation if the workspace is not accessible or input is invalid (FORBIDDEN, NOT_FOUND, VALIDATION_ERROR).

api_key_id.description: Existing API key record ID used to authorize this operation.

workspace_id.description: Workspace to create the new API key under.

name.description: Human-friendly name for the API key.

expires_at.description: Optional expiration timestamp; when reached the key is treated as revoked/expired for requests.

tool_schemas.name: maps_update_api_key
tool_schemas.description: Updates an API key’s mutable fields and/or revokes it according to the lifecycle; returns the updated API key metadata and refuses attempts to un-revoke or otherwise violate state transitions (CONFLICT, NOT_FOUND, VALIDATION_ERROR).

api_key_id.description: API key record ID used to authorize the update (may be the same as target or another permitted key).

target_api_key_id.description: API key record ID to update.

status.description: Lifecycle transition target. Only active→revoked is allowed.

tool_schemas.name: maps_whoami
tool_schemas.description: Returns the calling identity derived from the provided API key, including authorized workspace context, granted scopes, and current quota/rate-limit consumption; refuses invalid, revoked, or expired keys (UNAUTHENTICATED).

api_key_id.description: API key record ID used to authenticate the caller.

workspace_id.description: Optional workspace to scope quota and entitlement reporting; when omitted, returns the caller’s default/accessible set summary.
